verdict.rationale: LathamDrive offers a legal document generator that lets entrepreneurs create their own incorporation documents. Latham also co-developed the Automated Convertible Note, an OpenLaw-based generator with customizable market-standard terms, so this is genuine document assembly rather than static templates. Missing for 10: any description of the interactive online completion flow (questionnaires, e-signature, export), the range of document types beyond incorporation and convertible notes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the tools are live and self-serve.
